subject.title: fix(android): keep stale PTT from restarting capture

question: Should maintainers land this Android PTT ownership hardening after the changelog cleanup and exact-head Android lanes finish, or require additional device/emulator proof first?
rationale: The patch is a narrow source-level fix for a real Android microphone lifecycle race, but it changes capture ownership and foreground-service ordering in a way CI may not fully prove for real devices.

options.title: Land after cleanup and green Android lanes
options.body: Remove the release-owned changelog line, wait for Android unit/build lanes to pass on this head, then land under maintainer ownership of the remaining device-proof gap.

options.title: Require live Android proof
options.body: Ask for redacted device or emulator logs, recording, or terminal output showing stale PTT no longer restarts or tears down newer capture before merge.

options.title: Pause for deeper state-machine review
options.body: Hold the PR if maintainers want another Android owner to inspect the capture epoch and mutex model before accepting the availability risk.

recommendation.title: Land after cleanup and green Android lanes
recommendation.body: Remove the release-owned changelog line, wait for Android unit/build lanes to pass on this head, then land under maintainer ownership of the remaining device-proof gap.

likelyOwner.reason: He is assigned, authored the follow-up branch, and has the strongest recent history on this Android Talk/PTT lifecycle path.
